metadata.Name: STAIR Captions
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese image caption dataset based on the MS-COCO, Flickr8k, and Flickr30k datasets. It contains over 965,000 captions for more than 190,000 images, with five Japanese captions per image collected via crowdsourcing.
metadata.Paper Title: STAIR Captions: Constructing a Large-Scale Japanese Image Caption Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 17th Annual Conference of the International Speech Communication Association (INTERSPEECH 2016)
metadata.Abstract: Image captioning, which involves generating captions for given images, has been attracting a great deal of attention. One of the key drivers of recent progress in this field is the existence of a large-scale dataset. However, most of the existing datasets are for English, and there are no such large-scale datasets for other languages, such as Japanese. To address this issue, we constructed a new large-scale dataset of Japanese image captions, which we call STAIR Captions. This dataset is based on the MS-COCO dataset, which is one of the most popular datasets in the image captioning field. We collected five captions for each of the 164,062 images in the MS-COCO dataset (82,783 for training and 40,504 for validation, as in the original dataset, plus 40,775 for testing). This resulted in a total of 820,310 captions. To collect a large number of high-quality captions, we used a crowdsourcing service. We also developed a method for collecting captions that consists of three stages: translation, refinement, and re-captioning. In addition to the MS-COCO images, we also created Japanese captions for the Flickr8k and Flickr30k datasets. The STAIR Captions dataset is publicly available. We also present a quantitative evaluation of our dataset and a baseline for Japanese image captioning.
